## google-business-profile.mybusiness.categories.list

`GET` `https://mybusiness.googleapis.com/v4/categories`

Returns a list of business categories. Search will match the category name but not the category ID. *Note:* Search only matches the front of a category name (that is, 'food' may return 'Food Court' but not 'Fast Food Restaurant').

| --- | --- |
| Effect | `read` |
| Execution | `inline` |
| Idempotency | `safe` |
| Capabilities | `legacy-v4.read` |

| Output | `LegacyV4ListBusinessCategoriesResponse` |

**Parameters**

| Name | Location | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `languageCode` | `query` | `string` | No | No | The BCP 47 code of language. If the language is not available, it will default to English. |
| `pageSize` | `query` | `integer` | No | No | How many categories to fetch per page. Default is 100, minimum is 1, and maximum page size is 100. |
| `pageToken` | `query` | `string` | No | No | If specified, the next page of categories will be fetched. |
| `regionCode` | `query` | `string` | No | No | The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. |
| `searchTerm` | `query` | `string` | No | No | Optional filter string from user. |
| `view` | `query` | `"CATEGORY_VIEW_UNSPECIFIED" \| "BASIC" \| "FULL"` | No | No | Optional. Specifies which parts to the Category resource should be returned in the response. |
